findings.title: Quoting-hazard root cause: 3 hook callers shell out to store_learning.py with bash-style escaping that is wrong for the cmd.exe shell execSync uses on Windows (un-escaped & | < > ^ % backtick) — junk-creator / injection class
findings.telemetry: Count store_learning.py invocations whose argv after shell-split does not contain '--content'; grep TEMP for files whose names are command fragments (e.g. 'opc/400`'). corr-null 60.7% may partly be mangled stores.
findings.observe_how: Feed errorContext / user prompt containing & | ^ % > ` into the hook and watch the spawned cmd.exe split the command.

findings.title: Dead pipeline: agent-error-capture builds content starting with "Agent '" which is the FIRST entry in store_learning.py NOISE_PREFIXES — every store it attempts is gate-rejected before embedding; the hook still logs 'Stored failure learning'
findings.telemetry: SELECT count(*) FROM archival_memory WHERE tags @> '{agent_failure}'; expect ~0 despite hook firing. 30/36 agents never in agent-recall (SUMMARY) is consistent with agent-failure learnings never persisting.
findings.observe_how: Run agent-error-capture on any failure; store_learning returns {skipped:true, reason:'noise_prefix: Agent ''} at gate step 1.

findings.title: classify_scope uses substring `kw in combined` over GLOBAL_KEYWORDS containing short/common tokens ('go','git','agent') — 'good'/'category'/'management' false-trigger GLOBAL, mis-scoping PROJECT learnings into the cross-project GLOBAL recall surface
findings.telemetry: Sample archival_memory rows with scope=GLOBAL; count those whose content has no genuine cross-project token but matched 'go'/'git'/'agent' substrings. Relates to intent-pollution 24.6% / recall hit-rate 27.4%.
findings.observe_how: classify_scope('the good agent management page') -> 'go' in 'good', 'agent' in 'agent'/'management' => global_score>=2 => GLOBAL.

evidence.quote:
global_score = sum(1 for kw in GLOBAL_KEYWORDS if kw in combined)
    project_score = sum(1 for kw in PROJECT_KEYWORDS if kw in combined)

    if global_score > project_score and global_score >= 2:
        return "GLOBAL"

findings.title: _emit_store_quality_score is a synchronous timeout=2.0s HTTP POST invoked on EVERY gate outcome (incl. noise/too_short rejections), inside validate_learning_quality on the store hot path
findings.telemetry: When TRACE_TO_BRAINTRUST=true + the 3 BRAINTRUST_* env vars set, time a rejected-noise store; up to 2s blocking before the rejection returns. Count call sites: 6 emit calls (4 reject paths + 2 pass paths).
findings.observe_how: Set the 4 env guards, store a 5-char fragment; gate rejects at step 3 but still blocks on the feedback POST first.

findings.title: Silent store failures: dedup-search errors and all backend/embedding exceptions are swallowed; detached spawn callers use stdio:'ignore', so a failed store returns success-shaped or unseen — no telemetry that a learning was lost
findings.telemetry: Compare count of store_learning spawns (hook logs) vs archival_memory inserts/24h (system_health already surfaces 'No learnings stored in 24h'). Gap = silent losses. Relates recall hit-rate 27.4%.
findings.observe_how: Kill DATABASE_URL mid-session; store_learning_v2 returns {success:false,error:...} but detached spawn (stdio:'ignore') discards it; dedup search failure path just `pass`es and double-stores.

SEED-01 quoting hazard: root-caused — bash-style \" escaping wrong for cmd.exe that execSync spawns on Windows; metachars &|<>^%backtick un-escaped; content embeds arbitrary agent-error/user-prompt text → D3a-01 (S1)

embedding-write path (EmbeddingService provider='local' → LocalEmbeddingProvider BGE-large 1024-dim, in-process via sentence-transformers; get_embedder() singleton): NO daemon socket in this path — model loads in-process per `uv run python` invocation (latency/RSS cost, relates SEED-08); no corruption found; dim/model NOT flagged per instructions — CLEAN re corruption
BGE daemon interaction: store_learning.py does not contend with codegraph's BGE daemon (separate process); in-process load only — CLEAN

malformed-content corruption: gate rejects malformed-as-noise before embedding; real corruption risk is the SHELL layer (D3a-01), not the Python parser which uses argparse safely once args arrive intact
notes: Frozen-SHA note: working tree at review time is clean (HEAD 8723034); the `opc/400\`` artifact shown in the session-start git snapshot was NOT present when I checked (git status --porcelain empty; find found nothing) — I did not re-assert its existence. The quoting-hazard ROOT CAUSE (D3a-01) is VERIFIED in code regardless; the `400\`` filename is exactly the signature of a command split on an unescaped metachar (`... 400` fragment redirected to a file), consistent with SEED-01's 5 logged artifacts. Severity rationale: D3a-01 marked S1 (wrong hot-path behavior + injection surface) augmenting parent SEED-01 (S0 junk-creator); user-confirmation-detector is the worst leg (shell:true + raw user prompt + only escapes double-quotes, not even newlines). D3a-05 is the highest-leverage NEW finding: agent-error-capture's entire output is unconditionally gate-rejected (content always starts with 'Agent ''), so that hook persists nothing while logging success — likely contributor to the 30/36 agents-never-in-agent-recall telemetry. The Grep tool was hook-intercepted into semantic/AST search mid-review (returned 'No semantic matches' for literal patterns); I fell back to targeted read-only Bash grep and chunked Reads — all quotes copied verbatim from the files.
